PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1 : 3, 1 : 4, 1 : 5, 1 : 6, 1 : 9, 1 : 16, 1 : 18, 1 : 23 and 1 : 24 of Block 1, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 810818, situated in the Village of Polathu Palatha within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 24 A Polathu Palatha in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Balapitiya, in the District of Galle, in the Province of Southern, referred to in Notice No. 81/0313 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2342/40 of 27th July, 2023 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P.C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 30th July, 2024
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
